comparison.objective: Use tweezers to move a wafer into a carrier and twist-lock it; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Edge-only wafer handling, tweezer use, case alignment, and bayonet rotation versus hex-key engagement, collar adjustment, counterholding, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Wafer centered and undamaged, carrier seated and rotated 22–45 degrees; no repeated dynamic-response criteria.
comparison.reason: Precision handling and packaging are different from response-guided adjustment, notwithstanding a final rotary lock.
